summary: Digimarc Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a registered direct offering of 4,500,000 common shares at $4.04 per share, raising $18.18 million gross, or about $17.45 million net before $200,000 estimated expenses. Purchasers signed stock purchase agreements dated September 29, 2026; Needham Company, LLC acted as sole placement agent for a 4.0% cash fee. The referenced last sale price was $4.91 on September 25, 2026, a roughly 17.7% discount. The event is a capital-raising share issuance, resembling an overnight marketed equity placement, not a control transaction; watch dilution and use-of-proceeds disclosure.
